title: Reconcile public documentation with the live read-only gateway
objective: Replace stale current-state copy after the verified v0.2.0 GHCR, Render, DNS, TLS, REST, and MCP activation while preserving the separate unavailable state of authenticated submission, PyPI, GitHub Releases, MCP Registry publication, and the episte.media redirect.
required_evaluation: fresh public DNS, HTTPS, REST status, MCP discovery, tag, and image-identity read-back
focused tests proving current public copy distinguishes the live read-only gateway from the unavailable authenticated submission queue
full deterministic make check, disclosure audit, and changed-path audit
acceptance: README, mission current-state flags, status projections, llms.txt, launch guidance, and API/MCP documentation state that the anonymous read-only REST and Streamable HTTP MCP gateway is externally verified live
the documentation preserves the free-service cold-start and no-SLA boundary and does not imply write, arbitrary-fetch, admission, or deployment authority
the authenticated submission queue, episte.media redirect, GitHub Releases, PyPI package, and MCP Registry entry remain explicitly unavailable or unpublished
an append-only production receipt binds the v0.2.0 tag, accepted commit, GHCR digest, workflow, provider service, DNS targets, TLS, API/MCP identity, security probes, and limitations
historical activation records and the accepted research corpus remain unchanged
no merge, Pages deployment, new release tag, container publication, provider redeploy, DNS mutation, PyPI publication, or MCP Registry publication occurs in this task
limitations: The live gateway is a Render free-compute service that can sleep after inactivity and is not an availability commitment.
The gateway is read-only. GitHub draft pull requests remain the active autonomous submission queue; hosted MCP submission is not live.
Merging and coordinated static/runtime redeployment are separate owner-controlled gates because every public interface must retain exact release-identity parity.
